units.title: Place best-answer/body/solution controls in the desktop post content column

defect_currentness.original_finding_reconstruction: PR #52 introduced forum count strings using English '(s)' ordinary interpolation. Later PR #71 fixed sectionCount by moving it to the structured plural catalog/runtime, but deliberately left topicAndPostCount as '{{topics}} topic(s) · {{posts}} message(s)'. The accepted residual R5 defect is therefore narrower than the original broad count-string concern but remains present.
current_proof: canonicalEnglishCatalog.common.topicAndPostCount is still messageKind interpolation with two placeholders and literal English '(s)' markers.
CategoryRoute still calls t('topicAndPostCount', { topics, posts }) once, so neither count is resolved independently through i18next plural selection.
app/routes/category.tsx has not changed since PR #52.
later_pr_disconfirmation: PR #53–#61 did not change CategoryRoute count composition.
PR #71 added structured plural support and converted sectionCount only; topicAndPostCount remained unchanged.
PR #72–#88 did not change CategoryRoute and did not replace the combined key.

defect_currentness.original_finding_reconstruction: The PR #52/P2 review finding identified the combined topic/message count label as a presentation/i18n contract defect because independent grammatical number cannot be selected for two different counts inside one ordinary interpolation message.
current_proof: The same combined key and route call remain on post-R4 main.
Existing tests prove plural runtime capability for sectionCount but contain no regression proving independent topic/message singular/plural selection or mixed pairs.
later_pr_disconfirmation: PR #71 makes the intended fix mechanism available, but does not apply it to the combined topic/message label.
No later catalog/category test or route change closes this accepted finding.

defect_currentness.original_finding_reconstruction: PR #58 added best-answer label and solution form as direct siblings of header and ForumMarkdown inside .forum-post. The accepted P2 finding records that a two-column grid with no content-column wrapper/placement lets these direct grid items auto-place into successive cells/implicit rows instead of one stable desktop content region.
current_proof: Current .forum-post remains display:grid with grid-template-columns: 12rem minmax(0, 1fr).
Current TopicRoute still renders header, conditional .best-answer-label, ForumMarkdown (.post-body), and conditional .solution-form as separate direct children.
No grid-column/grid-area placement exists for those content siblings.
The max-width:38rem rule only switches .forum-post to one column; it does not repair desktop auto-placement.
later_pr_disconfirmation: PR #61 changed solution authorization/presentation availability and added unrelated auth/admin CSS; it did not add a content wrapper or placement.
PR #76 narrowed authorization failure masking; it did not change the post DOM structure or CSS.
PR #77–#88 did not change the relevant TopicRoute/CSS layout.

i18next.finding: Current i18next documentation requires the option name 'count' for plural selection and uses JSON v4 suffixes such as _one/_other, with additional locale-specific branches. This matches the repository's existing structured plural compiler/runtime.

css_grid.finding: Unpositioned direct children of a grid container are auto-placed one item per cell in source order; additional implicit rows are created as needed. This directly supports the current EX58-43 defect analysis.

rationale: REM-07 and REM-09 are both bounded presentation corrections with no DB/schema/dependency/domain-semantics coupling.
They share app/forum/public-read.test.tsx as the minimal route/render regression location, so splitting would duplicate review/CI/visual evidence while creating no isolation benefit.
The implementation can remain reviewable with separate commits for REM-07 and REM-09 inside one PR.

rem07_decision.selected_mechanism: Replace topicAndPostCount with two independent canonical plural messages and compose their already-localized fragments in CategoryRoute.
rem07_decision.route_boundary: CategoryRoute calls t('topicCount', { count: section.topicCount }) and t('messageCount', { count: section.postCount }) independently, then joins the two localized fragments with the existing neutral separator. No locale-specific plural branch is permitted in route code.

old_key.reason: One canonical message with two independent counts cannot use normal i18next count-driven plural resolution for both grammatical numbers. Keeping it as a supported canonical identity would preserve the defect.
old_key.local_manual_pack_impact: No checked-in ru/he manual pack contains topicAndPostCount, so app/localization/manual-packs.ts requires no change.
old_key.fingerprint_impact: No fingerprint registry/file requires manual editing. sourceFingerprint is computed per descriptor. New topicCount/messageCount descriptors naturally receive new fingerprints; unrelated manual-pack fingerprints such as heading remain unchanged.
old_key.persistent_raw_impact: Existing persistent_manual or machine rows for topicAndPostCount become historical unknown-key rows. Current DatabaseTranslationSource already skips unknown canonical keys and reports reason 'unknown-key'; this behavior has an existing regression.
old_key.persisted_bundle_impact: A persisted compiled bundle containing the removed key or an old bundleVersion is rejected by current bundle verification/deploy identity and request loading falls back safely. R5 must not add request writes or external cleanup.
old_key.external_data_boundary: No claim is made that old topicAndPostCount rows/bundles exist externally. R5 performs no external reconciliation. Any future external cleanup remains a separately authorized external operation.

rem09_decision.rationale: A wrapper makes .forum-post have exactly two direct grid items: author header and content region. That gives a structural content-column boundary without maintaining multiple conditional grid-column rules.

dom_boundary.author_region: Existing <header> remains a direct child of .forum-post.
dom_boundary.content_region: Add one .forum-post-content direct child containing the conditional best-answer label, ForumMarkdown output and conditional solution form.
dom_boundary.unchanged: Do not change loader/action/auth checks, solved/best-answer conditions, hidden inputs, post anchors, ForumMarkdown component or domain mutations.

css_boundary: Move shared content padding/min-width responsibility to .forum-post-content.
Remove the duplicated outer padding from .post-body so nesting does not double-pad.
Keep .solution-form spacing semantics; make .best-answer-label block-level only if needed to preserve the current label presentation.
Do not add explicit locale/direction layout branches or redesign the forum visual system.
rem09_decision.explicit_grid_placement_rejected_as_defa: Explicit grid-column placement on three conditional siblings can be made correct, but it leaves three independent grid items/rows and requires repeated placement rules. The single wrapper expresses the semantic content region directly and makes conditional rendering structurally stable.
rem09_decision.mobile_proof_boundary: At max-width 38rem the existing .forum-post rule becomes one column. With exactly header + content-wrapper as direct grid children, normal auto-placement stacks those two regions in source order. Existing mobile header border change remains valid; no extra breakpoint or redesign is required.

project_state_decision.reason: PROJECT_STATE records stage/architecture/current operational limitations, not individual forum presentation defects. R5 does not change stage completion, architecture, DB/external state, authorization semantics, translation job state or the currently documented R7 limitation.
